findings.change: Remove arbitrary output/receipt/report-size refusal. Preserve complete output to one ordinary owned artifact (stream when necessary), print a convenient summary separately, and report observer I/O/encoding failure distinctly from owner outcome. Preserve real source resource budgets and real child/test failures; do not increase thresholds or claim missing evidence passed.

findings.title: Whole production-tree cleanliness used as a replay identity proxy
findings.surface: explicit W18 holdout verify-freeze/run/bootstrap CLI, not canonical source read
findings.condition: any tracked or untracked difference anywhere in four production trees, including unrelated scripts/tools
findings.evidence: Actual verify_producer function with a synthetic repo and a controlled _git response reports only ?? tools/unrelated_notes.py and refuses before source/replay work. No real repository mutation.
findings.root_cause: Unrelated worktree state is used as a replacement for identity of code that really ran.
findings.change: Record actual loaded dependency identities and source commit/worktree fingerprint. Treat unrelated dirty paths as diagnostic. If the experiment explicitly needs committed-only bytes, automatically materialize only that runtime closure in an owned isolated directory rather than forcing all four trees clean. Preserve wrong-runtime/import-root detection and source/gold integrity.
bounded_tests: a real temporary Git repo with unrelated untracked tools file still runs/records actual identities
a change to a loaded producer dependency is detected in manifest/identity, never silently described as the requested frozen commit
wrong import tree remains an actual error; healthy concurrent work is not a permission veto

optional_efficiency.title: same-inode deployment verification can hash identical bytes twice in one operation
optional_efficiency.evidence: _reconcile hashes source, then destination, then samefile; an existing proper hardlink necessarily points to the same inode. New link also rehashes destination after source hash. No timing/model read measured.
optional_efficiency.recommendation: If optimizing deployment, use one verified handle/stat identity and validate actual samefile link ownership without hashing the same immutable inode twice in the same operation. Keep verification across new processes/time boundaries. Not a source eligibility or present user-permission blocker.
